verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing site claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance", so some approval capability is first-party documented. Nothing shows how it works: no multi-level chains (manager → budget owner → finance), no delegation, and no escalation for stalled requests. missing for 10: documented multi-step/sequential approver chains, role-based approvers such as budget owners, approver delegation, automatic escalation or reminders on stalled approvals, and any in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.
